meaningful_change.low_count_rule: Report counts and qualify percentages when a denominator is below the applicable minimum.

activated.definition: First meaningful changed browser-editor command after editor_loaded, with applicable consent.

downloaded.definition: CTA click or asset request, depending on the source; installation and launch are separate health signals.

returning.definition: Native local marker contains an earlier UTC calendar day and the client reports on a later UTC day.

exclusions.browser_test_rule: Use non-production hosts or decline analytics.
exclusions.unrecoverable_after_aggregate_ingest: Anonymous native dogfooding has no stable identity; suppress test runs at source and record the window.

desktop_health.after_update_rule: Only when the launch version matches the pending install target.
desktop_health.version_changed_rule: Manual or otherwise observed version change without the pending-target match.
desktop_health.target_version: Optional bounded semantic version on non-launch updater operations.
